title: Keto Aussie Skillet Scramble
description: A hearty, crunchy keto breakfast skillet dish featuring Australian-style scrambled eggs, broccoli, and a crispy skillet crust.
instructions: Preheat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped bacon and cook until crispy, flipping halfway through. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced Australian sausage to the skillet and cook until browned, breaking apart with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the broccoli florets to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
Push the sausage and broccoli mixture to one side of the skillet.
Crack the eggs into the other side of the skillet and scramble until cooked through.
Stir the eggs and sausage mixture together, then add the shredded cheddar cheese and stir until melted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the skillet scramble hot, topped with crispy bacon and additional cheese if desired.
